movelist.name: Gust
movelist.effect: If the target is airborne as a result of Fly or Sky Drop, Gust can hit them, ignoring Range and has a Damage Base of 8 instead.

movelist.name: Morning Sun
movelist.effect: The user regains Hit Points equal to half of its full Hit Point value. If it is Sunny, the user gains 2/3 of its full Hit Point value. If it is Rainy, Sand Storming or Hailing the user gains 1/4 of their full Hit Point value.

movelist.name: Absorb
movelist.effect: After the target takes damage, the user gains Hit Points equal to half of the damage they dealt to the target.

movelist.name: Air Cutter
movelist.effect: Air Cutter is a Critical Hit on 18+.

abilities.name: Pride
abilities.effect: While suffering from Burn, Poison, Paralysis, Freezing, or while Asleep, the user’s Special Attack is raised 2 Combat Stages. If suffering from none of these conditions, the user loses any Combat Stages gained this way.

abilities.name: Rivalry
abilities.effect: Whenever the user deals direct damage to a target of the same gender, increase the Damage dealt by +5.
